comportamentos: CustomVariable.reply_to falls back to ActionMailer::Base.default[:from] when the variable is missing or empty: missing (the candidate returns nil)
DeviseMailer sets the reply_to header from CustomVariable.reply_to: missing (it still uses @template.reply_to)
EmailTemplate#update_mailer_headers always sets headers[:reply_to] from CustomVariable.reply_to: missing (unchanged, so blank values are skipped and no default is used)
Per-template reply_to column on email_templates is removed and builtin templates no longer copy reply_to: missing
Seed value fixed to sapos@sapos.ic.uff.br: differs (the candidate sets it to an empty string)
Notifier applies the configured reply_to: present
justificativa: The candidate only trims and nil-checks reply_to and seeds an empty variable; it lacks the default sender fallback and the DeviseMailer/EmailTemplate header changes, so replies still get lost in several cases.
